USMLE-style practice · Pharmacology

Time to a new plateau

Choose the single best answer, then reveal the explanation.

A constant IV infusion of a hypothetical first-order drug is started with no loading dose. Its half-life is 6 hours and clearance remains stable. After 30 hours, approximately what fraction of the eventual steady-state concentration has been reached?

  1. Exactly 100%
  2. 97%
  3. 50%
  4. 75%
  5. 87.5%
Reveal answer and explanation
Correct answer

97%

Thirty hours equals five half-lives. The fraction achieved is 1 − (1/2)^5 = 96.875%.

Understanding the options

97%
Thirty hours equals five half-lives. The fraction achieved is 1 − (1/2)^5 = 96.875%.
50%
That is the fraction after one half-life.
75%
That is the fraction after two half-lives.
87.5%
That is the fraction after three half-lives.
Exactly 100%
The exponential approach is asymptotic; five half-lives is an approximation to steady state.
